pages._note: Master-entity steward view as a declarative type:detail page (pipelinq-pos-mdm-detail-declarative). The masterEntity register object's flat fields (masterId / entityType / status / dataQualityScore / aliases / mergedFrom / lastReviewedAt / gdprNotes / …) auto-render in the body via CnObjectDataWidget; the raw source-record children render as a relatedCollections table (sourceRecord, FK 'currentMasterEntity'). The parts no declarative primitive can express live in one kind:'section' bodyWidget (MdmGoldenRecordSection, after-related): the server-COMPUTED golden record (merge-rule survivorship) with per-attribute provenance (sourceSystem + trustTier) and the derived linkage lineage, fetched from GET /api/mdm/entities/{id} (a projection, not stored flat on the schema), plus the 'Resolve conflicts' modal which recomputes the golden record on save. KEPT-AS-NOTE: the golden-record / provenance / lineage are a host-app PROJECTION (computed, not stored), so they stay in the section rather than the auto-body. Missing primitive: a type:detail variant whose body is sourced from a host-app projection endpoint rather than (only) the OR object. The instance-wide Data quality + Duplicate candidates dashboards stay their own pages — they are not entity-scoped in the source.
